hardware.binding_screen: AMD Radeon Pro W7900 / gfx1100 / GPU0
hardware.api_screen: AMD Radeon RX 7900 XTX / gfx1100 / GPU1

software.production_control: retained asynchronous proposal graph, event/device handoff, and cached N2 target graph
software.candidate_kind: temporary harness-only parent graph assembled with hipGraphAddChildGraphNode and hipGraphAddMemcpyNode1D

candidate.mechanism: Clone the cached NextN proposal and N2 target graphs into two dependent child-graph nodes under one parent executable. Seven fixed-address D2D memcpy nodes inject B3 token IDs into both target metadata columns and append proposal ID/value rows to the existing bounded payload between the children.

api_screen.protocol: Two tiny captured child graphs on GPU1, counterbalanced nine batches of 2,000 launch+synchronize iterations; compare two direct launches against one dependent parent launch.

binding_w7900_screen.protocol: Same-loaded-model code_merge_intervals natural25 B3, both routes warm, 13 counterbalanced direct/parent pairs.

decision.reason: HIP child-graph composition adds launch overhead in the primitive screen, and the production-shaped parent also loses the retained proposal's early asynchronous overlap with scheduler/transaction planning. The binding screen regresses every pair by a 2.881-ms paired median, so no runtime wrapper, graph API surface, cache, flag, or fallback is retained.
decision.next_target: Advance D27-R2 to the refreshed Q5T16 ssm_out module ledger, reusing the prior exhaustive representation evidence and reopening only for a materially new source-faithful primitive.
